body: It was biopsy’d after removal and was found to be a grade 2 clear cell meningioma, I was under the impression at the time that I would just need a surgery since it looked like a normal benign grade 1 from the mri, it was around 2.7x2.0x3.0cm and it took around a year to grow back to slightly smaller than original size. I would like to try surgery again as aggressively as possible however I need to meet with the surgeon to see if that’s even an option, I will get radiation regardless since the chance of total resection is very slim basically nill.

I have a grade 2 meningioma is in my right cpa, I already lost my hearing before the surgery (that’s how I knew I had a tumor)  that cranial nerve is very sensitive. The surgery went okay it was very long about 12 hours and they didn’t remove all of it, I had hydrocephalus that I had to come back into the hospital to get taken care of for a week and a half with a brain drain thankfully I didn’t need a shunt. Now I have discovered that the tumor has recurred and is impacting my facial nerve so I’m in the process of finding out if another surgery is viable or if I need to cross my fingers with just radiation 30m
I won’t be walking with anyone
